phase_name: Add a live-specs-path lint plus its own both-polarity fixture suite

objectives.description: Build lint-live-specs-path.sh with a token-prefix heuristic and run it repo-wide

approaches_tried.approach: Token-prefix heuristic: flag bare specs/[0-9]{3}_ literals not confined to a $-prefixed scratch-root variable token
approaches_tried.reason: 52 false positives across 4 pre-existing suites (test-validate-handoff.sh, test-validate-no-task-references.sh, test-validate-return-meta.sh, test-validate-state.sh) that embed synthetic specs/NNN_ paths as inert JSON/text fixture data never filesystem-checked; distinguishing this from a genuine live-path dependency requires per-validator data-flow knowledge a grep-level lint cannot have

deviations.reason: Lint built and verified per plan, but produced 52 false positives with no achievable tightening that preserved generality; exercised the plan's own pre-authorized contingency to drop the lint and its suite, keeping the rule documentation in Phase 4
deviations.annotation: See Phase 3's #### Reasoned Exclusions in the plan file
